source: lab (captured, Orbbec Femto Mega RGB, background replaced by a sky-like gradient via Segment Anything 2 - see watermark)
units: pixels, seconds; image coords x right, y down, origin top-left

camera.evidence: centroids of the static basketball and shoe stay constant to +-0.3 px over all 49 frames (tracks/static_check.csv); no per-frame shift
camera.perspective_cues: original background removed (uniform blue-white gradient), so no floor, horizon or vanishing lines are visible. Camera looks down onto a floor: nearer floor objects appear lower in the image (shoe and basketball near the bottom are nearer than the bin/person). Floor contact rows: person feet y~535-551, bin bottom y=591, shoe bottom y=687, basketball bottom cut at 719. The exercise ball rolls toward the camera: its apparent diameter grows from 128 px (rest, frames 0-18) to ~228 px (frame 35) and >300 px before it leaves the bottom-left of the frame.

exercise_ball.description: large dark-grey (charcoal) inflatable exercise/gym ball with white specular highlights; the only object that travels
exercise_ball.notes: held by the person (partly behind the person's arms at the top, touching the bin on its right) in frames 0-20; pushed off and rolls toward the camera and to the left (image down-left). Cut by the bottom image edge from frame 32; from frame 36 the silhouette is strongly flattened/widened by wide-angle perspective near the image corner and the centre is uncertain; frames 39-45 centre is extrapolated. Leaves the frame after frame 45.

person.description: person in black hoodie and dark trousers, face masked white (anonymised); crouching behind the ball, left of the blue bin
person.track: tracks/person.csv (visible bbox centre cx_vis, cy_vis; mask centroid mask_cx, mask_cy)
person.notes: stays in place (no locomotion): holds the ball frames 0-20, releases ~21, flings arms up/out frames 22-33, then stays crouched with hands down. Lower body hidden behind the ball in frames 0-~22; full crouched figure (head top to feet) visible frames 29-48, bbox height ~187-204 px.

recycling_bin.description: blue rectangular recycling bin with white recycle logo and yellow decals, right of the person
recycling_bin.notes: slightly tapered (wider at top); top rim at y~487; person's hand/leg touches its left side in several frames

basketball.description: orange basketball on the floor, bottom centre-right
basketball.notes: bottom edge touches the image border (y=719), so the vertical extent may be cut by ~0-5 px; width 92 px is the reliable diameter

shoe.description: white sneaker with black stripes lying on the floor, bottom left
shoe.visible_frames: 0-34 and 44-48 fully; 35-43 mostly hidden behind the rolling exercise ball
shoe.notes: oriented diagonally (toe up-right); length along main axis ~85 px

events.event: exercise ball at rest, held by the person (centre wobble <= 6 px)
exercise ball starts moving (centre starts descending/moving left)
person releases the ball (hands leave the ball)
exercise ball first touches bottom image edge
no bounce, no collision with other objects observed; ball rolls continuously from release until it exits

files.tracks/static_check.csv: per-frame centroids and visible fraction of bin, basketball, shoe
